items.title: GLP-1 Coverage Fell From 72% to 60%. Is Eli Lilly’s Weight-Loss Boom Hitting an Insurance Wall?
items.summary: Employer insurance coverage for GLP-1 weight-loss drugs is shrinking, yet Eli Lilly just posted a 47% revenue surge. Something underneath the headlines is keeping volumes alive, and it changes how shareholders should read every coverage headline going forward.
